An element ID MUST be unique across all of a document's collections, not only within its own.
A reference can therefore never be ambiguous, and a diagnostic can name an element by its ID alone.

An ID identifies one element for as long as it exists: an edit changes an element's members, never its ID, and a deleted element's ID is not reused. That is a property of edits, so Floorspec Ops states it normatively; a single document cannot show it.
